newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-SWISS BOOST ATTACK FOR MATCH WITH NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWISS BOOST ATTACK FOR MATCH WITH NORWAY.

text.p: Coach Rolf Fringer has reloaded his attack for Switzerland's World Cup qualifier against Norway, naming Grasshopper strikers Kubilay Turkyilmaz and Nestor Subiat to his 18-man squad on Monday.
Deciding not to tinker with success too much, the two changes were the only ones made to the Swiss team that beat Finland 3-2 last month.

Turkyilmaz, a dangerous attacker who has the reputation of saving his best for international competition, scoring 20 times in 53 appearances for his country, rejoins the squad after missing the match in Helsinki because of a strained calf muscle.

Subiat, five goals in 14 caps, rejoins the national team after a much longer absence. He only returned to action two weeks ago after being out eight months with a torn achilles tendon and has yet to play a complete match.
Dropped to make room for the two strikers were veteran forward Adrian Knup and David Sesa.
Joining Turkyilmaz and Subiat up front will be Borussia- Dormund's Stephane Chapuisat who scored a pair of goals in his team's 3-1 win over Schalke 04 on Saturday.
The only question mark on the squad is Stephane Henchoz. The Hamburg defender has been bothered by back problems putting his participation in jeopardy.
Defenders - Brent Haas (Grasshopper), Stephane Henchoz (Hamburg), Yvan Quentin (Sion), Marco Walker (1860 Munich), Raphael Wicky (Sion), Ramon Vega (Cagliari)
Midfielders - Adrian Kunz (Neuchatel), Massimo Lombardo (Grasshopper), Blaise Piffaretti (Lausanne), Ciriaco Sforza (Inter Milan), Johann Vogel (Grasshopper), Murat Yakin (Grasshopper)
Forwards - Kubilay Turkyilmaz (Grasshopper), Nestor Subiat (Grasshopper), Stephane Chapuisat (Borussia Dortmund), Christophe Bonvin (Sion)
